title: Why So Toxic? Measuring and Triggering Toxic Behavior in Open-Domain Chatbots*
reasoning: The paper primarily focuses on measuring and mitigating 'toxicity' (defined as offensive language involving hate or violent content) in chatbots. While toxicity has ethical implications, the paper's core methodology and evaluation do not involve benchmarking or evaluating broader concepts of religion, morals, or ethics. The 'Ethics Considerations' section is a standard disclosure rather than a primary component of the ethical/moral benchmarking itself.
